FISHING LICENCE · CHILE

Chile fishing licence

Foreign visitors need a national recreational fishing licence for freshwater and sea fishing. Regional rules still apply; Castward's Futaleufú trip is in Los Lagos.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Foreign visitors, including children and seniors.

Who doesn’t

  • Age and registered-disability exemptions apply to Chileans and foreign residents, not visiting foreigners.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Foreign visitor weeklynon resident1 weekCLP 19900
Foreign visitor monthlynon resident1 monthCLP 39800
Foreign visitor annualnon resident1 yearCLP 59600

Saltwater

The foreign visitor licence covers both marine and inland waters nationwide, except protected waters where fishing is restricted.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the licence on paper or an electronic device.
  • Carry the licence when you transport your catch.
  • Release all salmonids on the upper Futaleufú between the international border and the Sofía sector.

How to buy

Buy through SERNAPESCA's recreational fishing portal, its offices, or authorized sales points. Foreign visitors use passport or DNI details.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Chile?

Foreign visitors need a national recreational fishing licence for freshwater and sea fishing. Regional rules still apply; Castward's Futaleufú trip is in Los Lagos.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Chile?

Foreign visitor weekly: CLP 19900; Foreign visitor monthly: CLP 39800; Foreign visitor annual: CLP 59600 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Chile?

Buy through SERNAPESCA's recreational fishing portal, its offices, or authorized sales points. Foreign visitors use passport or DNI details.
